The study reports the change directly, so I'll fill "hba1c_mudanca_media" with these values and set "hba1c_mudanca_tipo_dispersao" to "DP" since the numbers include ± standard deviation.

For the control arm (CD), the labels and descriptions are straightforward. The CRHP arm is the experimental group, so I'll label them accordingly and describe their interventions.

I need to ensure that any missing data is marked as "NR". However, in this case, most fields are filled, except perhaps some specifics about the dispersion type, which I've already addressed.
